output.headline: TPG Capital is an open-platform sponsor with 2 dental deals and 7 adjacent provider deals, and its $88M median deal fits the $80M target.
output.differentiator: Among open-platform sponsors on the list, TPG Capital's $88M median deal is the closest to the $80M target; Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, General Atlantic and Welsh Carson all run far larger medians. [T:record, A:angles]
output.why_them: Add-on to an open platform; right-sized provider buyer

acquirer_overview.title: A $303.0 billion sponsor with a broad, mostly closed record
points: TPG Capital is a financial sponsor with $303.0 billion in assets under management as of December 31, 2025. [B:buyer, P:1]
18 deals from 2016 to 2023; 15 of 18 (83%) closed and 17 of 18 (94%) were control deals. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share]
9 deals sit outside provider services and its home sub-sector is Health Insurance, so dental is not its main focus. [T:record, B:buyer]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An add-on to an open platform, backed by a provider record
points: Having bought from this kind of seller is the strongest factor in its likelihood, a modest one. Sector relevance and deal count are slight factors. [S:own_fit_s, S:sector_rel, S:activity]
Platform Build in 5 of 18 deals and High Growth in 10 of 18 point to buying and scaling assets. [M:platform_build, M:high_growth]
Its open platform makes the target an add-on; 2 own sub-sector deals and 7 adjacent provider deals support the fit. [A:angles, T:record]

precedent_activity.title: Two dental precedents, plus a Southeast provider deal
points: Granite Dental Network: $203M Platform Investment, 2021, at 12.2x. [D:MA-2021-0439]
Integrity Oral Health: $57M SPAC Merger, 2018, at 16.8x, the highest multiple among its dental precedents. [D:MA-2018-0420]
Quality Medical Group: $187M Minority Investment in the Southeast, 2022, at 11.2x; 3 of its deals are in the target's region. [D:MA-2022-0350, T:record]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible; the bid must clear the return gap
points: Comparable deals (63) show 11.0x at the lower quartile, 13.7x median and 15.4x at the upper quartile. [V:comps]
The 75th percentile is defensible: the 18.0% margin sits above the comps' 12.4% median, and above 92% of comps. [V:comps]
TPG Capital's own median paid is 15.7x, in line with the upper quartile. Ability to pay: 5.0x leverage at 8.5%, an equity cheque of $53M. [V:comps, V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 14.0% is below the 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 13.7x leaves the maximum price at $68M. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: The gap is on returns, not capital, given $303.0 billion under management. [V:lbo, P:1]

risk_flags.title: Growth fit runs against
risk_flags.concern: Target growth is not close to what it usually buys, a slight factor against. [S:growth_fit]
risk_flags.mitigant: High Growth is a motive in 10 of 18 deals. [M:high_growth]
risk_flags.reality: The factor is slight; the target's 8.0% growth and 18.0% margin remain the pitch. [S:growth_fit, X:target]

risk_flags.title: Crowded process, mid-list rank
risk_flags.concern: TPG Capital ranks 7 on the priority list of 10, with a likelihood of 5.1%. [R:rank]
risk_flags.mitigant: Conviction is High on its sub-sector record and open platform. [C:conviction]
risk_flags.reality: Other open-platform sponsors, such as Blackstone and Hellman & Friedman, are also on the list, so expect competition. [R:rank, A:angles]

conviction.rationale: Rests on 2 deals in the target's own sub-sector, 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, and an open platform offering the add-on route. The return at the ask is the main hurdle. [C:conviction, A:angles, V:lbo]
